facts.text: The Grand Junction Canal opened in 1796, turning Southall into a freight hub that sparked brick factories, flour mills and chemical plants.
Southall served as a municipal borough of Middlesex, governed from Southall Town Hall until the borough dissolved in 1965.
Otto Monsted built a margarine factory in Southall in 1894, later renamed Maypole Dairy, once the world’s largest margarine plant.
The first South Asian community arrived in Southall in 1950, recruited to work in a factory owned by a former British Indian Army officer.
R&B star Jay Sean grew up in Southall, a town that has produced several notable musicians.
Southall History, a website dedicated to the town’s past, showcases its heritage through a rich collection of photographs.
